tools.name: ask_henry
tools.description: Ask HenryKnows a question about F-1/J-1 student immigration, SEVIS, OPT, CPT or related rules and get a cited answer. Ask in the person's own terms; do not add identifiers. Answers take 10–40 seconds. Draws on HenryKnows' knowledge base and, when that is not enough, a live web search limited to offi

tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Search HenryKnows' knowledge base (regulations, SEVP/USCIS guidance, Federal Register rules, and HenryKnows' own explanatory notes, which are labelled "HenryKnows note" and link the source they rest on) and get the matching passages with their source links, so you can read and cite the text yourself

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect to the HenryKnows page the person is watching (its light turns green) and get the session for share_to_page. tools.name: share_to_page
tools.description: Add a question and its HenryKnows answer (or a search and its passages) to the thread on the HenryKnows page the person connected, so they can see it there with its sources. Only for people who connected a page. Side effects: appends one entry to that page's thread (up to 100; a full thread refuses

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_to_page · Private data: ask_henry · Public sink: share_to_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_to_page · Private data: ask_henry · Public sink: share_to_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
